To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the online social network can be conceptualized as a social proxy, that the Web site itself can be considered a primary actor in the online network, and that the online social networks can be conceptualized in terms of a consumer–site relationship.

online social networks can be described by a model that takes the Web site as an active actor in the social network, that online communities can serve as an online identity proxy for the individual consumer and that online social network analysis can be used as an exploratory tool for investigating online communities.

(1) the Web site is an actor within the social network; (2) the Web site acts as a social proxy, representing the community and individual consumers; and (3) online WOM has a direct influence on consumer evaluations and purchase decisions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social nature of online communities.
the role of WOM communication in online communities and how the Web site itself can be considered as a primary actor in online social networks.
how online communities influence the evaluation process and purchase decisions of consumers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Web is not simply a medium for information transfer, but that it is a new social space that has the potential to change the way people communicate and interact.
the results of this study indicate that the online community is a social proxy for the consumer, which is a new concept in online marketing.
the online community is a social proxy for individuals, and that individuals behave as though the Web site itself is an actor within the social network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a conceptual model of online WOM and the online social network that describes the interaction between consumers and a Web site.
online WOM is a complex phenomenon which requires a new conceptualization of online consumer social networks.
we have developed a conceptual framework for understanding online word-of-mouth communication within online communities and have identified several key concepts for future research.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online communities can have a significant effect on consumer behavior.
online social networks are not the same as offline social networks.
the Web site is the central actor in online social networks.
